answer: The document suggests that a focus on algorithmic bias and fairness in Responsible AI (RAI) research often assumes that these issues are solely due to poor implementation of a system, which centers attention on the algorithmic systems themselves. This focus can distract from validating the basic functionality of the systems and from addressing the underlying factors that lead to injustices. Additionally, it may lead to a narrow view that overlooks important contextual factors influencing the outcomes of AI systems, potentially resulting in harmful consequences.
